commander: Emperor Rudra (supreme authority). Operations directed by the Marshal (Velgrynd)
role: National armed forces: the Three Great Generals' legions plus intelligence and guard services
initialStrengthRaw: No whole-Empire headcount stated. V12 Ch4 sets 'more than one million elite' against the West's ~400,000
sizeEvidence: No figure is stated for the whole Empire. The >2,000,000 / <=1,000,000 figures in V12 Ch4 belong to the Armored Division (F-EMP-040). The V12 Ch4 comparison of 'more than one million elite' with the West's ~400,000 is a lower-bound remark, not a total (v12.txt:10200-10208).
finalStatus: Lost more than two-thirds of its war power. Ready to accept an unconditional-surrender treaty (Minitz at the V16 summit)
notes: R5: before the audit this row was 'Total mobilizable strength 2,000,000'. That figure belongs to the Armored Division and now sits on F-EMP-040. The ID is kept so existing references still resolve.

commander: General Caligulio (one of the Three Great Generals)
role: Largest legion of the Empire. Owner of the Jura invasion
initialStrengthRaw: more than two million mobilisable including garrisons across the Empire. At most about one million for an immediate operation
sizeEvidence: V12 Ch4 gives 'more than two million' mobilisable (with garrisons) and 'at most one million' at once under the heading of Calgurio's legion, the Empire's largest (v12.txt:10128-10135). Lower bound.
finalStatus: No longer able to fight after the Jura annihilation (Caligulio's own assessment, V14 Ch1)
notes: Fan TL label 'Mechs Legion' / 'Legion Mecha'. 'Marshal' is not Caligulio's title (the Marshal is Velgrynd).

role: Strength ceiling for an immediate operation (not a field formation)
initialStrengthRaw: at most about one million for an immediate operation
sizeEvidence: Stated for Calgurio's legion, not the whole Empire (v12.txt:10133-10135). V13 Ch1's '700,000 = about 70% of all imperial strength' fits this denominator (v13.txt:347-349, CON-005).
finalStatus: Pool from which the 940,000-strong Jura invasion army was drawn
notes: Subset of F-EMP-040. Never sum the two. Warcraft/Magic Beast and Hybrid/Composite are separate legions and are no longer children of this row (R5).

displayName: Imperial Army of the Jura invasion
role: Invasion of the Great Jura Forest
initialStrengthRaw: 940,000 ('he originally led an army of 940,000', V13 Ch4, '940,000 killed', V14)
sizeEvidence: Stated outright: Caligulio originally led 940,000 (v13.txt:16208). 940,000 imperial soldiers killed (v14.txt:1124, 4650, v14.txt:10133). Components 700,000 + 200,000 + 40,000 = 940,000 agree (DERIVED cross-check). 'Ninety-four thousand' at v13.txt:7057 and 18347 is a translation slip.
finalStatus: DESTROYED (V13 Ch2-Ch4): all killed except Miranda, Michel and Raymond. About 700,000 resurrected as prisoners (V13 Epilogue). About 240,000 could not be revived
source: V12 Ch4. V13 Ch2-Epilogue. V14 Ch1-Ch2. V16 Ch3
notes: Caligulio hand-picked the force from his legion (v12.txt:10208-10215). Placed under the <=1,000,000 ceiling. kia counts deaths. ~700,000 of them were revived (see CAS-021) and then held as prisoners (CAS-014). Permanent dead about 240,000.

commander: General Caligulio (direct). Major General Minitz led the labyrinth assault
role: Main ground effort against the capital Rimuru
initialStrengthRaw: seven hundred thousand. About 70% of all imperial strength
finalStatus: DESTROYED: 530,000 in the labyrinth (D+1.D+10) and 170,000 outside (D+11). Resurrected as prisoners (D+12)
notes: Fan TL 'Mecha Modification Corps'. Minimum individual ability C+, some at A. Soei rates the average about B with ~35,000 A-rank equivalents (v13.txt:427-460).

formation: Restructured Armor Corps - labyrinth assault echelon
commander: Not named for the mass echelon (Caligulio directing from outside). Major General Minitz led the hundred-strong elite team sent on D+9
role: Labyrinth Raider operation
initialStrengthRaw: 350,000 on day one, 150,000 on day two, 30,000 on day three
sizeEvidence: Sum of the three explicit daily entries (v13.txt:9489-9493). Rimuru later counts 'more than 530,000' defeated (v13.txt:13708-13709).
finalStatus: DESTROYED inside the labyrinth. Resurrected on D+12
notes: Register entity added in R5 so that the labyrinth share has its own movement and casualty rows. The text splits the corps this way. The grouping as a force is the project's.

formation: Restructured Armor Corps - camp outside the labyrinth
role: Reserve and field headquarters outside the labyrinth
initialStrengthRaw: 170,000 remained outside ('fewer than 200,000')
sizeEvidence: 'Reduced to 170,000 remaining' outside (v13.txt:9491-9493, 9520-9521). Rimuru and Caligulio say 'fewer than 200,000' (v13.txt:13716-13719, 16208-16209).
finalStatus: DESTROYED on D+11 by Carrera's Gravity Collapse, Geld's Second Corps and Diablo. Resurrected on D+12
notes: Register entity added in R5. Three individuals of the 940,000 survived (Miranda, Michel, Raymond), so the 170,000 kill figure is approximate.

role: Armoured feint and pressure on Dwargon
initialStrengthRaw: 200,000 personnel including maintenance teams. 2,000 Magic Guided Chariots, five crew each
sizeEvidence: 200,000 including maintenance. 2,000 magitanks with five crew each (v12.txt:10224-10238). Confirmed in the post-battle tally (v13.txt:6675-6676, 7531-7532).
finalStatus: DESTROYED on D+0 in under two hours. No prisoners. Among the ~240,000 who could not be revived
source: V12 Ch4 (formation). V13 Ch1-Ch3 (Gaster named, battle)
notes: Fan TL 'Magic Chariot Division'. Commander 'Geist' in the fan TL (= Gaster). Gaster is not named in V12.

formation: Flying Combat Corps - committed element (100 airships)
role: Air power over the Dwargon gate front
initialStrengthRaw: 40,000 personnel. One hundred airships committed
sizeEvidence: Only 100 airships were committed at Dwargon (v13.txt:3065, 4049, 8246-8249). 300 of the corps' 400 ships were kept to lift the Magic Beast Division (v12.txt:10863-10871). 40,000 personnel in the post-battle tally (v13.txt:6678-6679, 7532-7533). V12 also gives the whole air regiment as 100,000 (v12.txt:10257).
finalStatus: DESTROYED on D+0 by Ultima's Nuclear Flame (not Veldora). No prisoners. Not revivable
notes: Fan TL 'Air Combat Flying Corps'. Commander 'Faraga' (= Farraga). Carried the magicule-disturbing radiation weapon. '400 airships destroyed' was wrong: 100 were committed.

commander: Head not named in the war window. Lieutenant Tatsuya Kondo is its principal named officer
role: Intelligence, counter-intelligence and the forbidden-ritual operation
initialStrengthRaw: no headcount stated
sizeEvidence: No headcount. Bureau staff ("intelligence staff") guard Kagali's ritual ground with about 100 defenders in all (v15.txt:1352-1377).
finalStatus: Kondo killed by Carrera (V15 Ch5, confirmed V16 Ch3). Bureau otherwise UNKNOWN
source: V14 Ch3. V15 Ch1, Ch5. V16 Ch3
notes: R5: no longer merged with the Imperial Guardians (now F-EMP-015). Kondo holds the unique skill Reader.

role: Squads already marching in the eastern Great Jura Forest before the main body moved
initialStrengthRaw: 'some forces' / 'divided into several squads' (V12 Ch5). No number
sizeEvidence: Benimaru: some imperial forces have entered the Great Jura Forest while the chariots have not moved (v12.txt:12329-12331). Moss's clones track the Imperial Army divided into several squads in the eastern forest (v12.txt:12504-12506). No number is given.
finalStatus: Rejoin the main body when it halts at the forest edge (D-2). RECONSTRUCTED
notes: R5 canon resolution of the departure question: the forest elements seen at the D-33 council are advance squads of the invasion army. The main body leaves the next day (V12 Epilogue). Inside the 940,000. Never summed with its parent. Position and rejoining are RECONSTRUCTED.

commander: Not named in the war window
role: Emperor's elite guard. Members serve with the field army and aboard the flagship
initialStrengthRaw: no headcount stated
sizeEvidence: No total. Nearly 50 Guardian knights among the ritual-ground defenders (v15.txt:1352-1377). Krishna, a Guardian carrying a genuine resurrection bracelet (v13.txt:16282-16289). Malcolm, single-digit No. 8 (v15.txt:2303-2313). Guardian knights aboard the flagship (v15.txt:11073-11165).
finalStatus: Knights aboard the flagship killed by Testarossa's Death Streak (V15 Ch4). Otherwise UNKNOWN
notes: Added in R5 (split from F-EMP-014). Fan TL 'Near Guard' / 'Order of the Near Guard'.

commander: Gradim (one of the Three Great Generals)
role: Elite monster-riding legion. Airlifted strike on the West, diverted to Dwargon
initialStrengthRaw: only 30,000, each rider on a monster rated above A-
sizeEvidence: 30,000 riders on 30,000 monsters (v12.txt:10156-10160, 10870). About 60,000 to be lifted with mage auxiliaries (v14.txt:5945-5971). V15 Ch3: 10,000 died of the Demon Beast Fusion drug, 20,000 remained (v15.txt:9276-9306).
finalStatus: DESTROYED (V15 Ch3): 10,000 died of the fusion drug, the rest destroyed. Gradim killed by Carillon, his remains devoured by Vega
source: V12 Ch4. V14 Ch2. V15 Ch1, Ch3
notes: Fan TL 'Warcraft Legion' / 'Demon Beast Legion'. Separate legion of the Three Great Generals, not a child of the Armored Division (R5). kia is at least 10,000 (explicit) plus an unstated remainder. See CAS-024/CAS-025.

commander: Yuuki Kagurazaka (one of the Three Great Generals)
role: Mixed legion. Pressure on Dwargon and guard of the capital
initialStrengthRaw: total 200,000, of whom about 100,000 are fighting troops
sizeEvidence: Total 200,000. Half are intelligence or general-service personnel, about 100,000 fighting troops (v12.txt:10184-10187). 60,000 (60%) formed the Isthmus blockade (v14.txt:640-641, 12352-12355).
finalStatus: PARTIAL: the 60,000 Isthmus element was killed (V14 Ch4). The rest UNKNOWN. Yuuki was dominated by Rudra and later withdrawn with Feldway
notes: Fan TL 'Hybrid Legion'. Separate legion, not a child of the Armored Division (R5).

formation: Composite Division blockade force before Isthmus
commander: Deputy army commander Zero (senior officer on site). Yuuki nominal
role: Blockade of the Dwargon eastern metropolis (camouflage for a secret understanding with Dwargon)
initialStrengthRaw: sixty thousand troops (60% of the Composite Division) blockading Isthmus
finalStatus: DESTROYED by Velgrynd's Gravity Collapse on the night of D+18 (V14 Ch4). The corpses fed Kagali's forbidden undead ritual
source: V13 Ch1, Ch3. V14 Ch4. V15 Ch1
notes: The death is narrated in V14 Ch4. V15 Ch1 only refers back to the sacrifice. Zero restored order in the camp. The force never lost its command (EVT-0321 corrected).

role: Command staff
initialStrengthRaw: named staff only: Tolneod, Aria, Olca
sizeEvidence: Named individuals only (V14 Ch3). About thirty of Yuuki's sworn subordinates gather at his mansion (v14.txt:10083-10090).
finalStatus: UNKNOWN (caught in the purge of the coup night)
notes: Grouping is the project's. Aria is a disciple of Gadora.

role: Coup conspiracy
initialStrengthRaw: named members: Kagali, Laplace, Tear, Footman
sizeEvidence: Named members only (v14.txt:71-80, 255, 529).
finalStatus: Kagali, Footman and Tear withdrawn by Feldway at the end of the long night (V15 Ch5). Laplace guided Rimuru's party
source: V14 Prologue, Ch4. V15 Ch1, Ch5
notes: Fan TL 'Clown faction'. R5: no longer a child of the Composite Division (it is Yuuki's private faction). Miranda and Vega moved to Cerberus (F-EMP-051).

role: Undead raised from the 60,000 dead of the Composite Division
initialStrengthRaw: raised from the 60,000 dead. Number produced not stated (v14.txt:13914-13931, v15.txt:16796)
sizeEvidence: The ritual uses the 60,000 dead (v14.txt:13914-13931). How many undead it produced is not stated (v15.txt:16796).
finalStatus: Ritual lapsed. Loaded into vehicles and shifted away by Feldway (v15.txt:16809-16810, 17090-17101)
notes: Added in R6. Holds the ritual ground on the Dwargon eastern front after Velgrynd destroyed the blockade camp (v14.txt:13914-13931, 15251).

role: Underworld organisation of the Empire
initialStrengthRaw: three named heads
sizeEvidence: Miranda is one of the Three Greats (v14.txt:78, 255). Vega infiltrated the Magic Beast Division (v15.txt:10520). Damrada arranged Miranda's rendezvous (v14.txt:9900-9908).
finalStatus: Miranda killed by Kondo (D+18). Damrada revealed loyal to Rudra. Vega devoured Gradim and was withdrawn with Feldway
source: V14 Prologue, Ch3. V15 Ch3, Ch5
notes: Added in R5. Fan TL 'Three Greats'. Miranda was one of three survivors of the Jura annihilation before Kondo killed her.

role: Strategic air lift of the Magic Beast Division
initialStrengthRaw: three hundred airships
sizeEvidence: Strength is in airships, not personnel: 300 of the 400 air-corps ships were kept to lift the Magic Beast Division (v12.txt:10863-10871). 300 airships under Samuel (v15.txt:3452-3463).
finalStatus: Delivered the Magic Beast Division to the Dwargon eastern front instead of the central continent
source: V12 Ch4. V14 Ch2. V15 Ch1
notes: The 'Air Transport Command' label used before R5 is project-coined. The flotilla is placed under the Armored Division because V12 describes the air corps with Calgurio's legion.

commander: Major General Samuel (V16: Zamdo). Emperor Rudra and Velgrynd aboard
role: Command ship of the Emperor and the Marshal
initialStrengthRaw: one ship. Crew not counted
sizeEvidence: One named ship. Crew size not stated. Velgrynd emerges aboard as the Marshal and Rudra is aboard the same ship (v15.txt:3469-3570).
finalStatus: Nearly everyone aboard killed by Testarossa's Death Streak (V15 Ch4). Zamdo's group (several dozen) revived in homunculi (V16 Ch3)
notes: Added in R5 so that the flagship, which ends up over Jura, can be tracked apart from the flotilla delivered to Dwargon.

role: Marshal of the Empire and guardian dragon
initialStrengthRaw: single entity (uses Parallel Existence)
sizeEvidence: Single entity. Acts through several bodies at once (Parallel Existence, v14.txt:15488-15496).
finalStatus: Defeated by Rimuru at the end of the long night (V15 Ch5-Epilogue). Alive at the V16 summit as the former Marshal, names Masayuki emperor
source: V12 Ch4. V14 Ch4-Epilogue. V15. V16 Ch3
notes: The masked 'Marshal' of the V12 Ch4 council is Velgrynd (revealed V15 Ch1). Caligulio was never Marshal.

role: Head of state. All Federation forces
initialStrengthRaw: no national total stated. Field army 'more than 100,000' after reorganisation
sizeEvidence: No national total. Field army 'more than 100,000' after reorganisation (right wing 52,000 + left wing 50,000, v12.txt:4623-4625). Rimuru guesses the total with reserves at not less than 200,000 (v12.txt:4633). The 150,000 previously stored here is the Council's Western Army (F-ALL-002).
finalStatus: No deaths: Federation casualties stated as zero for the Jura campaign (v14.txt:4648). After the long night 'we are all safe' (v15.txt:18080-18083)
source: V12 Ch2. V14 Intermission. V15 Ch5
notes: R5: was 'Total national military potential 150,000', a misreading. The population passed one million.

formation: Right wing (First, Second and Third Corps)
role: Standing corps of the Federation
sizeEvidence: Right side of the organisation chart: First ~12,000, Second ~37,000, Third ~3,000 = about 52,000 (v12.txt:3984-3990). Revised chart 'right wing 52,000' (v12.txt:4623).
finalStatus: No deaths stated
notes: Added in R5 from the revised organisation chart.

formation: Left wing (Monster's Army and Volunteer Corps)
role: Newly raised formations
initialStrengthRaw: 50,000 (Monster's Army 30,000 + Volunteer Corps 20,000)
sizeEvidence: Left side of the chart lists the Western Army 150,000, the Monster's Army 30,000 and the Volunteer Corps 20,000 (v12.txt:4016-4024). The revised chart makes the left wing 50,000, keeping the 150,000 in the West (v12.txt:4623-4629).
finalStatus: No deaths stated
notes: Added in R5.

role: Defence of the Dwargon gate. Mobile shock
initialStrengthRaw: about 12,000 in the Green Corps (4,000 veterans and 8,000 later recruits). Plus one hundred wolf riders
sizeEvidence: About 12,000 (v12.txt:3737-3743, 3987). First Legion ~12,000 at the Dwargon gate (v13.txt:944-948). Hakuro leads the 12,000 on the supply raid (v13.txt:4078-4084).
finalStatus: ENGAGED on D+0. No deaths stated
notes: The force in contact at the start of the battle was the ~100-strong wolf-rider unit (F-TEM-001A), not the 12,000.

commander: Gobta (fused with Ranga). Gobchi leads the team once Gobta fuses
role: Opening contact and feigned defeat at the Dwargon gate
initialStrengthRaw: one hundred wolves and riders, each grown to A- level
sizeEvidence: 'One hundred wolves and riders', each A- (v12.txt:3737-3740). Only the Wolf Rider force is sent first against the magitanks (v13.txt:1505-1510). About a hundred sensed by Gaster (v13.txt:1729-1734).
finalStatus: Wounded but no deaths stated (restorative potions)
notes: Added in R5. Whether the 100 are inside the 12,000 is not stated: do not sum.

role: Engineering and heavy defensive line
initialStrengthRaw: about 37,000. Field-deployable 17,000 (Yellow 2,000 + Orange veterans 15,000)
finalStatus: ENGAGED on D+11 with 17,000 against more than 20,000 fleeing imperial survivors. No deaths stated
notes: Recalled from overseas work at the V12 Ch5 war council.

role: Impenetrable defensive line. Unit leaders
initialStrengthRaw: two thousand in the Yellow Legion
sizeEvidence: 2,000, individual ability about B+ (v12.txt:3764).
finalStatus: ENGAGED on D+11
notes: Fan TL 'Yellow Legion'.

role: Newly raised orc formation
initialStrengthRaw: 35,000 people, of whom fifteen thousand veterans can take the field
sizeEvidence: 35,000, of whom 15,000 veterans can fight. 20,000 on rear support and engineering (v12.txt:3774-3778).
finalStatus: 15,000 veterans ENGAGED on D+11
notes: Fan TL 'Orange Legion'.

role: Airborne guerrilla and air superiority
initialStrengthRaw: about 3,000
sizeEvidence: About 3,000 (v12.txt:3989, v13.txt:948). The figure does not visibly include the Hiryuu: do not add them.
finalStatus: ENGAGED. Badly wounded on D+0 but no deaths stated
source: V12 Ch2. V13 Ch1-Ch2. V15 Ch1

sizeEvidence: 3,000 volunteers from the Lizardman Warrior Corps, about C+ (v12.txt:3798-3807).
finalStatus: No deaths stated
notes: Fan TL 'Blue Legion'.

initialStrengthRaw: one hundred flying dragon troops (V13). One hundred Flying Dragons (V15)

finalStatus: ENGAGED. Several fell against Malcolm but none died (v15.txt:2496-2649)
source: V12 Ch2. V13 Ch1. V15 Ch1
notes: R5: was 'Flying Dragon element: hundreds / 300 developed', which mixed the Hiryuu with the Blue Numbers' 300 dragon mounts (now F-TEM-003C).

formation: Blue Numbers flying-dragon riders (about three hundred)

sizeEvidence: 300 chosen from the Blue Regiment fly with the Hiryuu at the Dwargon gate (v13.txt:2140-2142). About 300 Flying Dragons raised (v12.txt:3806-3807).
finalStatus: Withdrawn by Ultima during the feint. Flying Dragon losses counted as zero (v13.txt:5390-5392)
notes: Added in R5.

initialStrengthRaw: The Monster's Army - 30,000. One thousand leaders selected from among the Kurenai
finalStatus: ENGAGED on D+11. No deaths stated
notes: Raised largely from magic-born formerly under Clayman. '(Red Army)' gloss is not canonical.

role: Irregular unit outside the organisation chart, led by the 'Purple Crowd'. Its captains are sons of Dagruel

In the battle '10,000 mages of every kind' act under the Yomigaeri's lead (v13.txt:17198-17204).
finalStatus: ENGAGED on D+11. No deaths stated
notes: R5 canon resolution (CON-010): the 10,000 are the Pro-Guard, not the Yomigaeri. Earlier revisions merged the two units. The Yomigaeri are F-TEM-005Y. V12 says the unit is not under the regular command. Parent set to the national node.

initialStrengthRaw: 'hundreds of them' (V12 Ch2). About 100 (official keyword page)
sizeEvidence: V12 Ch2: the Yomigaeri led by Shion number in the hundreds (v12.txt:3889). The official keyword page describes about 100. Carried as ~100.
finalStatus: ENGAGED on D+11 leading the Pro-Guard. No deaths stated
notes: Split from F-TEM-005 in the R5 canon resolution (CON-010). Strength from 'hundreds' and the official keyword page: RECONSTRUCTED.

finalStatus: UNKNOWN: no engagement of this corps was located in V13-V15
notes: Added in R5.

finalStatus: No losses: the labyrinth battle ended without losses on Tempest's side (v13.txt:13703-13704)
notes: Ramiris is an allied demon lord. The garrison is placed under the Federation node by inference.

notes: Added in R5.

role: Special air attack on the ritual
